_comment: What this pack measured when it was last validated.
It is a record, not an input: the gates live in profile.json and are checked
by scripts/validate-pack.mjs. This is here so a later run can see whether a
number moved, and by how much, rather than only whether it still clears a
profileFoldDigest: see validate-pack output; changing it invalidates the built index

_note: Three backfill runs took the syllabus from 1,088 tests to 1,722, and every
one of the 135 topics is now at or above its size-scaled target. The gap
the coverage report was built to expose is closed.
keptRatioPct covers two of the three runs. gen-stats.json is written when
a run finishes, and the middle run was stopped by hand before it wrote
anything, so roughly 270 shipped tests have no rejection-rate data. C6
reads green on what it can see, not on everything.
lemmas.json.gz predates scripts/build-lemmas.mjs and is NOT regenerated:
its citations carry the pack's citations.mjs rewrite. The builder is run
in --verify mode only; it reproduces 242,733 of 242,746 shipped keys and
would add 3,888 more. That difference is documented drift, not a defect.
